question: The national income of India is estimated by?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Central Statistical Organisation**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The Central Statistical Organisation (CSO) is responsible for estimating India's national income and other macroeconomic indicators.
 
• CSO operates under the **Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation** (MoSPI).
 
• National income estimation includes key metrics such as Gross Domestic Product (GDP), Net National Income (NNI), and Per Capita Income.
 
• The CSO uses advanced statistical methodologies and data collected from various sectors to compute national income.
 
• Established in **1951**, the CSO plays a vital role in maintaining statistical standards and providing reliable economic data for policymaking.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **National Income:**

 
 
• It refers to the total value of goods and services produced within a country over a specific period, typically a year.
 
• It is calculated using three methods: **Production Method, Income Method, and Expenditure Method**.
 
• National income serves as a key indicator for measuring the economic performance of a country.
 
 
 
• **Gross Domestic Product (GDP):**
 
 
• GDP is the monetary value of all finished goods and services produced within a country's borders in a specific time period.
 
• It is the most commonly used metric to assess a country's economic health.
 
• GDP can be calculated using three approaches: **Production, Income, and Expenditure**.
 
 
 
• **Central Statistical Organisation (CSO):**
 
 
• In addition to national income estimation, CSO is responsible for conducting statistical surveys, compiling national accounts, and maintaining the Index of Industrial Production (IIP).
 
• It publishes comprehensive reports such as the **Annual Economic Survey** and **National Accounts Statistics**.
 
• CSO collaborates with state governments and other agencies to ensure accurate data collection and analysis.
 
 
 
• **Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation (MoSPI):**
 
 
• MoSPI oversees statistical activities in India and ensures uniformity in data collection across different sectors.
 
• It also manages the National Sample Survey Office (NSSO), which conducts socio-economic surveys.
 
• The ministry plays a crucial role in evidence-based policymaking by providing accurate and timely statistics.
